title: 考研主题练习 03 · 证据与复杂问题
description: 原创缩编练习，学习情境为虚构，覆盖非听力题型。参考考研英语一的历史材料、人工智能和环境治理章节，全文为原创缩编内容。

sections.title: 写作
sections.instructions: 按题目要求完成写作。提交后查看参考范文，自行核对。
study_paragraphs: Researchers should balance a clear conclusion with uncertainty by stating exactly what their evidence can support. A conclusion that lists every doubt may be impossible to use, but a confident claim that hides limitations can mislead readers. Researchers can separate the main finding from the conditions under which it was observed, explain what remains unknown and suggest a test that could reduce uncertainty. Clarity tells us what the evidence shows, while uncertainty tells us how far we should go.

sections.title: 选词填空
sections.instructions: 从词库选词，每词只用一次。
paragraphs: Historical objects can answer questions only when studied in [1] ______. A single letter may seem to [2] ______ a whole society, but its writer had a particular purpose and audience. Researchers [3] ______ it with other records and [4] ______ what is missing. Digital tools can make collections more [5] ______, yet they cannot automatically explain why an object was created.
study_paragraphs: Historical objects can answer questions only when studied in context. A single letter may seem to reveal a whole society, but its writer had a particular purpose and audience. Researchers compare it with other records and consider what is missing. Digital tools can make collections more accessible, yet they cannot automatically explain why an object was created.

questions.explanation: 第 1 空填入 context，结合上下文和句法关系判断。
第 2 空填入 reveal，结合上下文和句法关系判断。
第 3 空填入 compare，结合上下文和句法关系判断。
第 4 空填入 consider，结合上下文和句法关系判断。
第 5 空填入 accessible，结合上下文和句法关系判断。

sections.title: 信息匹配 · 证据与复杂问题
sections.instructions: 根据段落内容完成匹配。
paragraphs: [A] A museum displayed old tools beside modern versions. Visitors handled safe replicas and read about materials. The aim was to show the problems each object solved, not simply rank old and new.
[B] An archive noted that a photograph was taken by a colonial official. It explained whose viewpoint was present and which people could not record their own experiences.
[C] An AI image tool reconstructed a historical street. The team labelled it as a reconstruction and linked the sources.
[D] A coastal town restored wetlands after floods. Engineers measured water, and residents described earlier flows.

sections.title: 阅读理解 · The missing comparison
sections.instructions: 阅读短文，选择最合适的答案。
paragraphs: A report claimed a new teaching method raised scores by comparing one class before and after. It did not compare a class using the old method. A later review found the new class also received extra sessions and had a different timetable. The school began a broader trial with comparable classes before making a strong claim.

sections.title: 阅读理解 · A shoreline with two records
sections.instructions: 阅读短文，选择最合适的答案。
paragraphs: A coastal village kept weather-station measurements and fishers’ marks of where waves reached the harbour wall. A planner noticed that fishers had recorded short storms the station missed. The records did not always agree, but together they showed where water moved quickly. Local observation did not replace instruments; it showed them where to look closely.

sections.title: 翻译 · 中译英
sections.instructions: 完成翻译，提交后查看参考译文。
paragraphs: 环境治理需要长期的观察和合作。科学家可以通过仪器收集数据，居民则能够提供对当地变化的日常经验。把这两类知识结合起来，有助于发现风险、改进政策，并让更多人理解保护环境为什么需要持续行动。
study_paragraphs: Environmental governance requires long-term observation and cooperation. Scientists can collect data with instruments, while residents can offer everyday knowledge of local changes. Combining these kinds of knowledge helps identify risks, improve policies and show why environmental protection requires sustained action.

questions.answer: Environmental governance requires long-term observation and cooperation. Scientists can collect data with instruments, while residents can offer everyday knowledge of local changes. Combining these kinds of knowledge helps identify risks, improve policies and show why environmental protection requires sustained action.
